channel.title: Just A Pinch Recipes - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Just A Pinch Recipes (justapinch.com)

item.title: Kitchen Sink Soup
item.description: Filled with flavor and textures, no one will miss a bit of fat when enjoying this healthier soup. Ground turkey adds a lean protein, and dicing up mushrooms bulks up the soup. Kale is nutrient-dense and has a nice flavor mixed with the sweet carrots. We loved the hint of smokiness from chopped bacon. With a bit of this and that, this homemade soup recipe can be thrown together pretty quickly, so it's great any night of the week when craving a warm and comforting bowl of soup.

item.title: Are You Kidding Cake
item.description: We can see why this dessert is named what it is. When people ask you how you made it and you tell them, they're going to say are you kidding me! We love how this is made with three ingredients (that are probably in the pantry already) and you can mix and match different boxed cake and pie filling flavors. We opted for lemon cake mix and blueberry pie filling and went with the extra inch on the hips version. The cake is nice and fluffy. The bits of cream cheese you get add a punch of tangy flavor

item.title: Creamy Chicken Cobbler
item.description: This creamy chicken cobbler is a hearty and comforting dinner on a cold evening. It has a filling like a creamy pot pie, but the topping is like a light and fluffy biscuit. Together each bite just melts in your mouth. Using a store-bought rotisserie chicken means you can have this weeknight meal on the table in under 45 minutes from start to finish.

item.title: Caramelized Banana Bread
item.description: Caramelizing the bananas before baking this banana bread adds a richness that's hard to describe. The smell during the caramelizing process is intoxicating. It really brings this simple bread to a whole new level of yumminess. One bite you know this isn't an ordinary banana bread. It's tender, rich, and delicious. The top forms a sugary crust but the rest of the bread is fall-apart tender and full of banana flavor.

item.title: Peggi's Gigantic Melt In Your Mouth Crispy Peanut Butter Cookies
item.description: Voted Members' Choice! We are so glad to have been able to try these wonderful cookies... delightfully sweet and perfectly peanut buttery they live up to their name. They're slightly crisp around the edges with a tender center. Once baked, they're big like a bakery-style cookie. If you love peanut butter cookies, these are a must-make.

item.title: Texas Tamale Balls
item.description: Now, these may look like your average meatball, but they sure don't taste like them. They are full of Tex-Mex flavor. Crushed Fritos not only serve as the binding agent but add the corn flavor that makes these smell and taste similar to tamales. The chili sauce is a nice complement and the flavor soaks into the meatballs while simmering in the slow cooker. If you need an appetizer, these are definitely different and everyone will keep coming back for more.

item.title: Baked Taco Dip
item.description: Warm, gooey, and cheesy, you won't be able to stop eating this baked taco dip. The refried beans and ground beef mixture has just the right amount of taco seasoning. A layer of sour cream mellows the flavors a little bit. There's an ample amount of melted cheddar cheese on top. Serve with corn chips or tortilla chips for a yummy game day snack or taco night appetizer.

item.title: Pank-Crusted Chicken Breast
item.description: An easy and delicious way to prepare chicken breasts. The coating is savory and full of flavor. Adding fresh thyme and lemon adds a freshness to it. The hints of citrus linger in every bite. Once fried, the crust is crisp and the chicken is tender and juicy.

item.title: Bacon Cheesburger Skillet
item.description: This bacon cheeseburger skillet is a homemade Hamburger Helper, but so much better. It's filled with hearty ground beef, smoky bacon, and onion. Rotel adds a little kick of flavor. Stirring in shredded cheddar cheese adds creaminess to the skillet meal. A great budget-friendly dinner idea that your entire family will love.
